name: Noah Smith

affiliations.role: Senior Director of NLP Research, co-director of OLMo

bio: Noah A. Smith is a professor at the University of Washington's Allen School, its inaugural vice provost for artificial intelligence, and a senior director of NLP research at Ai2. Smith works on natural language processing and machine learning, directs the OLMo open language model effort with Hannaneh Hajishirzi, and was previously on the faculty at Carnegie Mellon University.
known_for: Co-directing the OLMo open language model effort at Ai2
Author of Language Models: A Guide for the Perplexed
Research on evaluation methodology and NLP
Co-author of Don't Stop Pretraining and Self-Instruct
